raw:
@q query
  select ?c
  where all
    match
      relation "renew"
      role subject "Gemma"
      role object ?c
      role time "last March"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "flag"
      role subject "the audit committee"
      role object ?c
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
